description: Painted sprite for the patrol pawn (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/patrol-pawn.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the royal patrol PAWN from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose, chunky proportions and the shape of the helmet, not for its style. SUBJECT: a common royal patrol guard. On his head a compact plain steel kettle helm: a round dome with a short downturned brim all round and a small pointed comb on top, no upswept points. A plain guard's face: bare skin with two black dot eyes under short stern brows, NO moustache, no beard, no nose, no mouth. A royal-blue tunic with a gold edge at the hem and collar, rounded royal-blue pauldrons with thick gold edging on both shoulders, dark chainmail sleeves, brown leather gloves, short dark boots. A long pike held upright in his right fist on the right side of the figure: a wooden shaft, a steel leaf-shaped spearhead and a small gold collar under it. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the head and helm are about half the figure's height. EYES: two small black dot eyes painted into the face under the stern brows, side by side, level, a little toward the right side of the face, clearly visible. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal, polished royal blue with gold trim. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
